title: Watch ‘Everybody to Kenmure Street’ Director Felipe Bustos Sierra Break Down the Decades of Activism That Led to One Spontaneous Protest
summary: At IndieWire's Art of the Doc event, Sierra explained why his film had to introduce Glasgow's long history of social justice protests in order to contextualize its events.

title: Watch Emmy Rossum and Hulu’s ‘Furious’ Team Explain How They Found Humanity in a Broken System
summary: The star and executive producer of Hulu's hit crime show joined Quincy Tyler Bernstine, Steve Way, and composer Ariel Marx at Vidiots on October 16 for a screening and Q&A with IndieWire.

title: Jafar Panahi Faces Five-Year Prison Sentence in Iran After Releasing ‘It Was Just an Accident’
summary: The Oscar-nominated filmmaker and Palme d'Or winner has also been banned from travel and social media activity for two years.

title: ‘Manhood’ Review: Penis Enlargement Documentary Curves Left of Center
summary: Daniel Lombroso's certainly bizarre but sensitive portrait follows a PhalloFill entrepreneur (it's what it sounds like) and two of his clients as they walk us through a cosmetic phenomenon whose main clientele are insecure men.

title: Will ‘You Can See Everything’ Catch ‘Fahrenheit 9/11’ to Be the Highest-Grossing Documentary Ever?
summary: Nathan Fielder's doc is a cultural sensation, but it's unlikely to match the fervor around Michael Moore's seminal George W. Bush screed.

title: ‘The Mosquito Bowl’ Review: ‘Friday Night Lights’ Meets ‘Five Came Back’ in Peter Berg’s Formulaic Netflix Movie About a World War II Football Game
summary: Ray Nicholson and Bill Skarsgård star in an unexceptional sports drama that falls well short of a first down.

title: ‘The Gilded Age’ Review: Season 4 Is Team Bertha’s Time to Shine
summary: In a season laced with career aspirations and complications (supplementary to the lace gowns and lavish meals, of course), Julian Fellowes and Sonja Warfield's effervescent period drama sees Carrie Coon's rising socialite ascend to another plane.

title: ‘I Play Rocky’ Wins Virginia Film Fest Audience Award as Peter Farrelly’s Stallone Drama Readies for Theaters
summary: Exclusive: The Anthony Ippolito breakout vehicle was TIFF's first runner-up and has since wowed festival and tastemaker crowds.

title: Gotham Film Awards 2026 Nominations Spread the Love from ‘All of a Sudden’ to ‘The Invite’
summary: "All of a Sudden," "Clarissa," "La Gradiva," "The Invite," and "Tender Loving Care" lead overall nominations with four each. This year's selection also brings back the Audience Award.

title: Luchino Visconti’s Tragic, Beautiful Final Film ‘L’Innocente’ Restored in 4K — Watch the Trailer
summary: The 1976 marital melodrama joins Visconti classics like "White Nights" and "Conversation Piece" in returning to theaters, restored.

title: How Two Rival Columnists Created Hollywood’s Gossip Machine — and Taught America to Worship Attention
summary: In this excerpt from her new book "Hollywood Whispers: The Untold Story of the Original Gossip Queens, Louella Parsons and Hedda Hopper," author Eileen Cope charts the origins of a legendary show business rivalry.

title: Watch ‘My Undesirable Friends’ Director Julia Loktev Recall the Week Russia Invaded Ukraine
summary: At IndieWire's Art of the Doc event, Loktev explained why her film about the lives of Russian journalists had to take a different turn.
